answers.text:
- **Purpose**: Own the full approved Marketing editorial experience: Today, Plan, Create, Review, Learn and persistent Content, with campaign-free project scope, economical external article/media intake and optional generation. Preserve useful native drafts, claims, evidence, reviews, human approval and publish history while implementing the complete accepted I16 outcome.
- **Primary users/verticals**: The human owner, authorized editorial agents and genuine voluntary scoped contributors.
- **Deployment surfaces**: Existing local Connect-RPC API, native CLI and substantially overhauled Content Desk UI.
- **Value promise**: Beautiful purpose-specific composition with truthful exact-revision decisions, specialist-owned media/time/release operations, safe recovery and measured learning. An article-first increment is not completion.

- Preferred stacks / frameworks: Existing Go, Connect-RPC, native CLI and React/TypeScript/Vite; reuse governed shared components.
- Data + storage expectations: Content Desk owns editorial, project, revision/package, source-work and import relationships in its native storage. Asset Studio owns bytes; no credentials here. Additive/versioned migration preserves IDs and unknown history, with backup restoration and rollback after new writes.
- Integration strategy: Channel Manager owns action-specific readiness, timed release and outcomes; Personal Planner owns accepted human-time allocation; Asset Studio owns media candidate/provenance/release; Brand Manager owns visual brand authority; Offer Desk owns commercial truth. Optional Agent Manager/Prose routes use qualified callers, existing policy and visible all-attempt accounting. Generated artifacts use their governed owner.
- Non-goals / guardrails: No new Cadence product, private scheduler/media store, automatic human approval, mandatory paid regeneration, provider credentials or fabricated engagement. Strategic canon, scoped founder-guide versions and paired skills retain their owners; adapters record exact pins rather than fork instruction authority. AUTH qualification and external-effect authority remain separate.

- Required resources: Existing scenario-local storage; no new dependency install in this reconciliation.
- Scenario dependencies: Existing Content Desk specialist contracts with Channel Manager, Asset Studio, Personal Planner, Brand Manager, Offer Desk, Prompt Manager, Agent Manager/optional Prose Studio and Search Hub; bounded unavailable/partial states preserve the manual/external route.
- Operational risks: Exact package/revision/consent/timing binding, uncertain consequential responses, unsupported provider controls, privacy scope and retained historical fixtures.
- Launch sequencing: Canonical approved specification then disabled finite commission preparation; AUTH owner qualifies native admission separately. Delivery implements all accepted outcomes and independently verifies functional/visual/runtime evidence before closure. An early imported article proves one increment only; no real publication is required to fabricate qualification.

- Look & feel: Adopt the selected Marketing 0.3 Modernist Press original 47-state set locally for Content Desk, with task-specific Today, Plan, Create, Review, Learn and Content composition rather than a universal three-pane dashboard. See root DESIGN.md and experience registry.
- Accessibility: Close visual fidelity with justified truthful-data and accessibility adaptations; keyboard/focus/screen-reader, actual phone browser, 320 CSS px reflow, 200% text, 400% zoom, 44px targets and rendered WCAG AA contrast; dark/reduced-motion/reduced-data and no-art forms.
- Voice & messaging: Show exact actor, object, package/revision, decision scope, known/unknown/save/release status and actionable reason. Never substitute a toast or optimistic claim for a durable receipt.
- Branding hooks: Preserve shared semantic/focus/accessibility floors and valid install assets; this scoped visual amendment does not change other scenarios.

Governing approved sources and exact receiving pins: docs/internal/goal/materials/marketing-accepted-v1/{approval.md,documents/commission-accepted-basis/document-text.md,documents/dossier-accepted-basis/document-text.md,selected-assets.json,source-register.json}. Full owner approval: Sentinel_7062584135208191865fc82f43a4ded8, 2026-10-04 20:54 UTC. This document describes desired accepted behavior; retained requirement status/evidence do not certify the widened scope.

targets.title: Campaign record and lifecycle
targets.description: The system shall persist campaigns with theme, audiences, channels, hypotheses, and status, and shall refuse to activate a campaign that carries no supporting evidence reference

targets.title: Artifact slot budget
targets.description: The system shall enforce declared campaign/channel/format slot budgets for campaign-attached drafts, charge each such draft once, and admit campaign-free drafts without fabricated campaigns or collection/family slot charges.

targets.title: Draft lifecycle enforcement
targets.description: The system shall persist each draft with an explicit status and shall reject any transition not declared in the lifecycle contract

targets.title: Shared claim library
targets.description: The system shall store factual claims as first-class records that many drafts may cite, rather than as annotations owned by a single draft, and shall anchor each citation to the span of draft text it supports

targets.title: Evidence strength
targets.description: The system shall record each claim's evidence as either a citation or a re-runnable check with an expected result, and shall distinguish the two

targets.title: Verification gate
targets.description: The system shall refuse to move a draft to approved while any claim it cites is unverified

targets.title: Operator-only approval
targets.description: The system shall accept approval only from a human operator identity and shall record which actor approved which draft, in what capacity, and when

targets.title: Post-type registry and activation gate
targets.description: The system shall hold the post-type registry with activation state and shall refuse approval of any draft whose post type is not active

targets.title: Review scoring
targets.description: The system shall record a review run against the post type's declared failure modes with a per-mode verdict and supporting evidence

targets.title: Publish ledger
targets.description: The system shall record what shipped — draft, channel, URL, post identifier, series, and prior post — and shall serve that history as a query surface

targets.title: Subject familiarity state
targets.description: The system shall answer whether a named subject has already been introduced to a given audience

targets.title: Narration ledger
targets.description: The system shall answer what has already been narrated about a given scenario so that a later draft advances rather than repeats it

targets.title: Idempotent state import
targets.description: The system shall import existing marketing team state from its current file storage without duplicating any item on re-run

targets.title: Operator workbench
targets.description: The system shall provide a UI to work the draft queue, open a draft, resolve claims, read review output, and approve, and shall state the specific cause whenever approval is unavailable

targets.title: Draft authoring and revision
targets.description: The system shall let the operator compose and revise a draft's body directly in the workbench, and shall record each revision with whether an operator or an agent produced it

targets.title: Integrated Marketing workspace and durable Content home
targets.description: The system shall provide purpose-specific Today, Plan, Create, Review and Learn modes plus a persistent Content collection and authorized search; preserve exact native object/revision links, selected scope, return filters and browser navigation; distinguish new, active, quiet, no-match and unavailable states; and explain, rank and persist dismissal of bounded next-action suggestions without inventing work.

targets.title: Project scope and campaign-free admission
targets.description: The system shall admit a draft into one stable owning project/subject reference or explicit Unassigned independently of an optional native campaign, keep private working title distinct from public headline/opening, support the proportionate one-off route without fabricated campaigns or spoofed post types, and preserve native identities through additive project creation, filtering and migration.

targets.title: Content relationships and guarded reassignment
targets.description: The system shall preserve exact pinned source/derivation relationships and independent variant revisions; permit at most one native campaign and one primary same-project family per draft; treat saved collections as non-owning projections that consume no artifact slots; and preview detach/archive/move effects on membership, access, evidence and active releases without hidden cascade or identity loss.

targets.title: External article intake and resumable partial admission
targets.description: The system shall preview and admit existing text, structured article content, links, media placements and independently useful variants without regeneration, recording source artifact/revision, external producer and import intent; preserve originals and named derivatives; return exact per-item admission receipts or unresolved outcomes; reopen admitted work after restart; and reconcile or resume only unresolved items without title-based merge, duplicate body import or loss of rejected fields.

targets.title: Pending media and released package linkage
targets.description: The system shall preserve draft-media candidates with original-byte manifest, source position, intended role/order/caption/alt text, rights and Asset Studio candidate version/state; show pending, missing and rejected media without treating them as released; and convert exact Asset Studio review/release receipts to released references while retaining lineage and enforcing distinct asset-review authority.

targets.title: Adopted method and producer provenance
targets.description: The system shall resolve and record the applicable adopted method/source/adapter revisions and local exceptions by assignment and type/channel, retain native strategic/post-type/paired-skill authority and the scoped Drive founder-article guide, expose unknown historical method pins, and support scoped change review/adoption/rollback without editing independently authoritative instruction copies or invalidating unrelated accepted work.

targets.title: Immutable packages and scoped editorial decisions
targets.description: The system shall materialize revision-bound or content-addressed editorial review packages covering exact body/structure, media versions/order/crop, links, accessibility text, author, method/source basis and decision scope; distinguish destination-unbound wording acceptance, craft assessment, native human-only ApproveDraft and separately bounded release authority; preserve request-changes anchors and restore-as-new-revision history; and invalidate only affected decisions when consequential package fields change.

targets.title: Revision-bound evidence anchors and dependency impact
targets.description: The system shall bind claim support to the exact body revision, declared offset convention, quoted span/digest and contextual locator including ordered thread item identity; mark ambiguous or changed anchors stale; retain evidence strength and verified-claim gates; and show permission/source/offer changes and affected claims, variants, plans, packages and releases without mass rewrite or leakage through secondary surfaces.

targets.title: Guarded operations, fingerprints and reconciliation
targets.description: Every mutating Content Desk command shall validate actor/scope and expected revision and persist its stable operation key with a canonical exact-request fingerprint; same-key same-request replay returns the admitted receipt, changed payload conflicts, and authorization-checked lookup remains available throughout recovery. Composite work shall retain stable child keys and individual receipts, reconcile uncertain effects before retry, and preserve admitted state on denial or partial failure.

targets.title: Explainable strategy and content-mix proposals
targets.description: The system shall support distinct ongoing Vrooli and app campaign briefs, compose versioned AI-assisted candidate channel/type/angle/date plans from accepted canon and pinned factual/offer/account/work inputs, expose reasons, constraints and omissions plus a meaningful lower-effort alternative, enforce slots separately from distinct remaining human effort, and record owner acceptance/defer/rejection without implicit publication or strategic-canon adoption.

targets.title: Source work identity and Personal Planner allocation
targets.description: The system shall own stable Marketing preparation work IDs with occurrence/source revision, dependencies, remaining effort and completion meaning; project each source key once through Personal Planner registration/projection contracts; request accepted allocations through native preview/apply; retain native Planner IDs, stale-revision conflicts and tombstones; count shared work once; and expose provisional/unreserved and partial admission without inventing calendar authority.

targets.title: Unified publication intentions and three time layers
targets.description: The system shall persist one intention per exact variant/destination, separately project desired publication, Personal Planner human allocations and Channel Manager admissions/actual receipts, support date-only civil dates, dayparts and instant/window with original IANA zone and DST ambiguity handling, and preview stale basis, capacity conflict and reschedule impact without turning a drag, copy or plan acceptance into external schedule or publication.

targets.title: Capability-aware exact release and outcome recovery
targets.description: The system shall prepare manual handoff, supported provider schedule and qualified connected release from immutable exact publication packages and action-scoped account evidence; bind actor/destination/allowed timing atomically or through explicit recoverable admissions; preserve local queue, provider scheduled/held, owner-reported, verified, partial, unknown and cancel-requested distinctions; and expose ordered-item and route-specific reconciliation/control limits without duplicate dispatch, immediate-release substitution or unsupported provider promises.

targets.title: Genuine contributors and exact consent lifecycle
targets.description: The system shall support bounded voluntary contributor briefs and included/excluded packet previews, manual external handoff or authorized scoped invitation with authenticated response evidence, actual attribution/affiliation and contributor-controlled final wording, versioned permitted use/account/window consent, decline/withdrawal/revocation and independently reported outcomes; latest consent changes shall block local dispatch and invoke truthful provider cancellation/correction responsibility without fabricated testimony, shared credentials, automatic contact or engagement manipulation.

targets.title: Privacy, authenticated scope and recovery policy
targets.description: The system shall enforce server-side authenticated read/command scope and permitted cross-project references; disclose and restrict selected provider context, contributor packets and exports; apply revocation to search snippets, notifications, thumbnails and cached excerpts; and implement a disclosed permitted local recovery branch with shared-device/project exclusions, explicit clearing, retention/backup limits and account-switch/session-expiry isolation without sending old-account drafts under a new identity.

targets.title: Recoverable editing and truthful asynchronous state
targets.description: The system shall retain common base, server revision and permitted local branch during concurrent edits, failed/malformed/unknown saves, offline work, session expiry and scope changes; distinguish device save, confirmed server save, queued sync and unknown result; preserve typing/selection/scroll and copy/export fallback; link recoverable operation records from affected objects; and provide exact next actions without relying on transient toasts or optimistic success.

targets.title: Readable export and verified archive restore
targets.description: The system shall preview and export permitted text/structure, selected revisions, source/media/rights/alt/method/provenance relationships, review scopes, receipts and observations as readable content and a versioned credential-free machine archive; warn on omitted dependencies; dry-run explicit namespace/mapping and new/existing/conflicting/unsupported restore; recover partial imports without unrelated overwrite; and separately prove round-trip fidelity, archive/restore and truthful deletion/recovery/external-copy limits.

targets.title: Optional authoring capability and bounded accounting
targets.description: The system shall qualify an optional agent/Prose authoring route against the same brief, permitted evidence, adopted method and output-quality contract as economical external authoring; disclose actual runner/model/provider/locality, selected span/context and budget/accounting source; retain candidate provenance and all-attempt/partial/failed usage; enforce supported ceilings across concurrency or show their absence, truthful cancellation and stale-result comparison; and keep manual/intake/export/planning useful without generation.

targets.title: Observations, corrections and bounded learning
targets.description: The system shall join manual reported and imported verified observations to native release/item, exact package/account, definition/version, collection source, observation time, interval, unit/denominator and limitations; deduplicate identical events and retain correction/supersession/conflict lineage; preserve incomplete values as unknown; and support evidence-linked questions, experiments and accepted next proposals without competing metrics storage, fabricated causality or implicit strategy/method/recurrence adoption.

targets.title: Selected visual, responsive and accessibility fidelity
targets.description: The system shall implement close fidelity to all 47 selected Marketing 0.3 states with task-specific composition and documented truthful-data/accessibility adaptations; use provenance-aware actual-preview/context-art/typographic/no-art fallback, no mandatory image generation, and dark/reduced-data/motion forms; and demonstrate keyboard/focus/screen-reader, actual phone browser, 320 CSS-pixel reflow, intermediate/wide layouts, 200 percent text resize, 400 percent zoom, 44 by 44 touch targets and rendered 4.5:1 ordinary-text/3:1 large-text-essential-control contrast.

targets.title: Compatible migration, reversible rollout and operations handoff
targets.description: The system shall inventory and classify existing data/fixtures/settings before additive or versioned migration, preserve stable IDs and historical scope/receipts/unknowns with controlled explicit backfill, prove supported backup restoration separately from user archive restore, retain saved routes or redirects, validate rollback after post-cutover writes, associate exact running build and acceptance evidence, and hand over monitoring/recovery/ownership without promoting a partial increment or unqualified provider route to whole-effort completion.

targets.title: Native structured content formats and independent variants
targets.description: The system shall provide native post, ordered thread, long-form article, image/carousel and source-linked video planning/script/handoff composition with format-specific constraints, media order, caption/alt/link/accessibility data, exact item identities and independently editable variant snapshots; preserve incompatible or rejected imported fields explicitly rather than flatten them, and never claim universal video rendering or activation of unsupported post types.

targets.title: Claim re-verification sweep
targets.description: The system should re-run stored checks on a schedule and should mark a claim stale when its result changes

targets.title: Published-post contamination report
targets.description: The system should list every published post that cites a claim which has become stale or refuted

targets.title: Novelty claim expiry
targets.description: The system should require a search date on novelty claims and should return them to unverified once that date passes a configured age

targets.title: Coverage reporting
targets.description: The system should report marketing coverage by campaign, lane, channel, and SKU, including staleness

targets.title: Account eligibility check
targets.description: The system should consult Channel Manager for whether an account is eligible for a lane before a draft targeting that account is approved

targets.title: Publish handoff contract
targets.description: The system should hand an approved draft to Channel Manager, should re-run the verification gate at handoff and refuse release when evidence changed after approval, and should record the returned URL and post identifier against the ledger

targets.title: Assisted claim extraction
targets.description: The system should propose claims extracted from a draft body for operator confirmation, as a cross-check on author self-reporting

targets.title: Federated retrieval registration
targets.description: The system should register drafts and publish history as a search-hub provider so they are reachable from federated query

targets.title: Image attachment
targets.description: The system should attach Asset Studio released media references with role, dimensions/aspect, alt text and position, retaining candidate lineage and storing no image bytes in Content Desk.

targets.title: Post-type-shaped authoring surface
targets.description: The system should shape the editor to the draft's post type, presenting per-post character budgets and break structure for a thread and headings, a banner slot, and inline figures for a long-form post

targets.title: Agent invocation from the workbench
targets.description: The system should let the operator commission a drafting, evidence-hunting, or review run through agent-manager from the workbench, and should present the result as editable content with its provenance recorded

targets.title: Claim coverage over draft text
targets.description: The system should show which spans of a draft body are supported by a cited claim, and should surface assertions that carry none

targets.title: Contamination remediation
targets.description: The system should record a remediation against a contaminated publish record, carrying its kind and its state, so that a detected false statement resolves rather than only reporting

targets.title: Publish performance ingestion
targets.description: The system may ingest per-post engagement telemetry once social accounts and measurement sources exist

targets.title: Per-channel variant derivation
targets.description: The system may derive independently editable variants from exact source revisions; unchanged evidence may be reused only for supported wording/current scope, and editorial or release approval is never inherited.

targets.title: Identity-consistent media linkage
targets.description: The system may extend Asset Studio linkage to qualified identity-consistent generation; required image/carousel composition and video planning/script/handoff remain covered by the accepted P0 delivery without mandatory persona production.

targets.title: Outcome-driven hook promotion
targets.description: The system may propose hook-library promotions from measured post outcomes rather than editorial taste

targets.title: Conversational draft iteration
targets.description: The system may support conversational revision of an open draft, so that an instruction to tighten or cut a passage is applied in place without leaving the editor

targets.title: Desktop packaging
targets.description: The system may ship as a Tier 2 desktop application through scenario-to-desktop, which is the external delivery target rather than hosted deployment
